newsitem.title: FRANCE: CNCA sees Banque Indosuez positive 1996.
newsitem.headline: CNCA sees Banque Indosuez positive 1996.

text.p: Banque Indosuez should turn in a positive 1996 result, Lucien Douroux, chief executive of the bank's controlling shareholder, Caisse Nationale du Credit Agricole, said on Thursday.

"By all appearances it will produce a positive result for 1996," Douroux told reporters during a news conference on his bank's plans following the July acquisition of 51 percent of Banque Indosuez from holding group Suez.
Indosuez made a 1995 net attributable profit of 107 million francs after a loss of 1.089 billion francs.
Credit Agricole is aiming for a nine percent return on equity by 1998 and thereafter will aim for 12 percent, he told the news conference.
